verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents API onboarding for a custom UI, an embeddable Account onboarding component that keeps sellers inside the platform's app, identity verification for connected accounts, and management of external accounts for payouts. That covers the core of API-driven seller onboarding. However, several named elements are not explicitly evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented Stripe-hosted onboarding flow, terms-of-service acceptance capture, explicit KYB (business verification) as distinct from identity verification, explicit bank-account linking during onboarding, and independent hands-on corroboration of the embedded component.

support.subject: As a developer, I can onboard a seller through the API — KYB and KYC, bank account linking, and terms acceptance — with hosted flows and embeddable components when I don't want to build the forms

citations.quote: You embed the Account onboarding component directly in your application and your connected accounts go through the onboarding flow without leaving your application.
API onboarding: You use the Stripe API to build your own customized onboarding UI.
Use identity verification to reduce risk on your platform when using Connect.
Manage payouts and external accounts for your connected accounts.
